description: This file defines the SugarFieldImage class, a specialized subclass of SugarFieldFile, used for handling image fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It provides methods for rendering image list views and saving uploaded images, including validation and file management.

classes.name: SugarFieldImage
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldFile to handle image-specific behaviors in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, such as image validation and rendering in list views.

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to assign the module context for rendering the image in list views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles upload, validation, and storage of image files, managing removal, duplication, and remote linking.

methods.name: verify_image
methods.description: Validates that an uploaded file is a proper image.

methods.name: fillInOptions
methods.description: Populates display parameters and configuration options for image handling, including module override and file identifiers.
